Definition: to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to strike, strike off; 1a) (Piel) to strike off skin; 2) to go around, compass, round; 2a) (Qal) to go around; 2b) (Hiphil); 2b1) to go around, surround, encompass, enclose; 2b2) to make the round, complete the circuit; 2b3) to make round, round off
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
